You will be given the root cause of a bug, the commit message and the corresponding patch.
        You need to extract all code statements that lead to the bug from the patch, based on the root cause and the commit message.

        Root cause:
        The bug was caused by the incorrect prediction of the LRO timeout value based on hardware capabilities, which could lead to suboptimal performance or functionality. Instead of selecting the best available timeout, the code was using a hardcoded index that did not account for the actual supported timeout periods, resulting in potential mismatches between the desired and available timeout values.
        
        Commit message:
        net/mlx5e: Choose best nearest LRO timeout

Instead of predicting the index of the wanted LRO timeout value from
hardware capabilities, look for the nearest LRO timeout value.

Fixes: 5c50368f3831 ('net/mlx5e: Light-weight netdev open/stop')
Signed-off-by: Saeed Mahameed <saeedm@mellanox.com>
Signed-off-by: Mohamad Haj Yahia <mohamad@mellanox.com>
Signed-off-by: David S. Miller <davem@davemloft.net>  
        
        Patch:
        diff --git a/drivers/net/ethernet/mellanox/mlx5/core/en_main.c b/drivers/net/ethernet/mellanox/mlx5/core/en_main.c
index 7eaf38020a8f..5c8ab3eabe9c 100644
--- a/drivers/net/ethernet/mellanox/mlx5/core/en_main.c
+++ b/drivers/net/ethernet/mellanox/mlx5/core/en_main.c
@@ -1971,9 +1971,7 @@ static void mlx5e_build_tir_ctx_lro(void *tirc, struct mlx5e_priv *priv)
 	MLX5_SET(tirc, tirc, lro_max_ip_payload_size,
 		 (priv->params.lro_wqe_sz -
 		  ROUGH_MAX_L2_L3_HDR_SZ) >> 8);
-	MLX5_SET(tirc, tirc, lro_timeout_period_usecs,
-		 MLX5_CAP_ETH(priv->mdev,
-			      lro_timer_supported_periods[2]));
+	MLX5_SET(tirc, tirc, lro_timeout_period_usecs, priv->params.lro_timeout);
 }
 
 void mlx5e_build_tir_ctx_hash(void *tirc, struct mlx5e_priv *priv)
@@ -3401,6 +3399,18 @@ static void mlx5e_query_min_inline(struct mlx5_core_dev *mdev,
 	}
 }
 
+u32 mlx5e_choose_lro_timeout(struct mlx5_core_dev *mdev, u32 wanted_timeout)
+{
+	int i;
+
+	/* The supported periods are organized in ascending order */
+	for (i = 0; i < MLX5E_LRO_TIMEOUT_ARR_SIZE - 1; i++)
+		if (MLX5_CAP_ETH(mdev, lro_timer_supported_periods[i]) >= wanted_timeout)
+			break;
+
+	return MLX5_CAP_ETH(mdev, lro_timer_supported_periods[i]);
+}
+
 static void mlx5e_build_nic_netdev_priv(struct mlx5_core_dev *mdev,
 					struct net_device *netdev,
 					const struct mlx5e_profile *profile,
@@ -3419,6 +3429,9 @@ static void mlx5e_build_nic_netdev_priv(struct mlx5_core_dev *mdev,
 	priv->profile                      = profile;
 	priv->ppriv                        = ppriv;
 
+	priv->params.lro_timeout =
+		mlx5e_choose_lro_timeout(mdev, MLX5E_DEFAULT_LRO_TIMEOUT);
+
 	priv->params.log_sq_size = MLX5E_PARAMS_DEFAULT_LOG_SQ_SIZE;
 
 	/* set CQE compression */
